_doc: Names the platform accepts for verticals. A vertical itself is defined by its config files (config/<vertical>_kpi_catalog.json and friends), never by code. `aliases` maps short or legacy names to the canonical vertical. `id_prefixes` pins the short prefix used in generated IDs; a vertical with no entry gets one derived from its name. `legacy_id_first_segments` lists first segments that older IDs may carry. Platform code must not name a vertical: tests/test_platform_names_no_vertical.py enforces it.
